subject: Added Functionality to Deducer's Plotting GUI

messages.author: 0df794c86d6a2d68
messages.subject: Added Functionality to Deducer's Plotting GUI
parts:
Hello Ian,

First of all, I want to congratulate you on your GUI implementation of
the ggplot2 graphing package. I think your choice of the ggplot system
will make Deducer a successful GUI to the R program.

I am in the middle of writing a continuing professional development
course in exploratory data analysis that will be offered primarily to
property appraisers. The software we chose for the course will be a
combination of Excel and R. We intend to use RExcel to allow
spreadsheet data to be passed to R where students will primarily use
the plotting function. At this time, it is my thought to use Deducer
as a GUI to R.

In experimenting with Deducer, there is some functionality available
in R Commander that I could not find in Deducer at this time. Could
you please tell me if the following is on your list to add to Deducer:

a) The ability to save plots in various image file forms such as JPEG,
PNG, PDF, etc.

b) the ability to copy the script used to generate a plot so that it
can be pasted in a Word document.

Thank you again for your wonderful contribution to the R system.

Charles Abromaitis

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Added Functionality to Deducer's Plotting GUI
parts:
Hi Charles,

a) Create your plot. hit Run. in the generated JavaGD, the file menu
lets you save as pdf or eps.

b) In the plot builder go to Tools>view call. When you hit Run, the
call is sent to the console where it can be copied.

ian

messages.subject: Re: Added Functionality to Deducer's Plotting GUI

Thank you for the direction. I was able to fulfill these actions with
the Deducer plotting function on my laptop running the Ubuntu OS, with
the JGR GUI, so okay there. However, when attempting these same tasks
on my desktop running with Windows 7 0S, with the Deducer GUI embedded
in the R console, hitting run resulted in R unexpectedly closing
without any warning. I reinstalled R (the patched version), updated
all the packages, and repeated the same steps. The same result
occurred. I'm a novice on reporting what appears to be a bug; if you
need additional information, please let me know.

Charles
